Short answer: we want a clean, partner-friendly resolution here. Can you confirm the first-contact date and whether Orbit has an existing MSA or referral agreement with Remora? That determines the canonical owner per our channel policy.

Proposed next steps:
- Orbit to confirm: first-contact date + any signed paperwork (reply to this thread)
- Internal: Sergio + Marissa to map routing rules and call out exceptions
- Joint 30-min alignment call (suggest Thu 8/13 11am PT) to confirm who will lead the close and the mutual action plan

Quick internal note (copied back to Orbit so we're all aligned):

Policy baseline (draft):
- Partner-led: partner initiated contact AND signed referral/MSA OR a documented POC where partner owns primary contact.
- Redwood-led: Redwood AE reached out first and partner is a downstream integrator.
- Escalation to arbitration if both parties can plausibly claim "first contact" or there is ambiguous ownership in CRM.

For Remora specifically, if Orbit can provide: (1) first-contact timestamp, (2) a signed agreement or written statement of introduction, we'll mark it partner-owned. Otherwise we default to Redwood AE ownership and offer referral crediting.

I've attached a short draft of routing rules and a proposed exception flow for strategic accounts. If everyone agrees, Karthik can publish a temporary routing rule scoped to "Remora Health / Orbit Apps" while we finalize.

Marissa
